new_page.h1: Citadel Houses for Sale | Port Coquitlam Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Citadel. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Citadel, Port Coquitlam: 20 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 2 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Citadel fell from 23 in June to 20 in October (−13.0%), and 21 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 14.6% of Port Coquitlam’s 137 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Citadel?
Citadel also had 21 condos and townhomes listed and 5 sold in October, against 20 houses listed. The Citadel condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Citadel home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

30 houses sold in Citadel with a median price of $1,390,000 (the middle half sold between $1,226,250 and $1,579,250), taking a median of 10 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $472 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 5,412 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Citadel?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 20 houses listed in Citadel. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Citadel a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Citadel had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Citadel from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 21 houses sold in Citadel over those 5 months, out of 91 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Citadel?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Citadel sell for?
faq.a: 30 houses sold in Citadel between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,390,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Citadel?
faq.a: The median was 10 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
